external_transfer.selection_policy: Source validation selection retained; all new districts are test-only

district_holdout.summary_interpretation: The mean-validation model field describes the six-fold summary only. Each fold uses its own independent validation selection; no global architecture is deployed from the test ranking.

limitations: One drive per district; three target districts in one city, no cross-city conclusion.
The map has a fixed 5m reference height; height/lever-arm uncertainty remains despite guards.
Mask 0/360 closure discrepancies are preserved in an uncertainty envelope.
Boundary and spatial margins are engineering guards, not calibrated label error bounds.
F9P splitter antenna and map labels differ from KLT camera-labelled captures.
Quality and boundary exclusions change the evaluation population; coverage must accompany scores.
KLT-to-UrbanNav transfer changes geography, acquisition dates, antenna and reference-label method together.
Within UrbanNav, receiver/label method match, but district and acquisition date remain confounded.
Six train/validation directions reuse three drives; they are not six independent test datasets.
Scores condition on accepted static-building references; unknown rows remain unscored.
One seed and no independent-drive confidence interval; no cross-city or universal model winner claim.

dataset.source_commit: Public 2021 release; downloaded file SHA-256 pins define the inputs
dataset.license: UrbanNav README has no explicit data reuse license; SatRef personal noncommercial internal use; raw/derived tables not redistributed
dataset.features_origin: Pinned GPL KLT RTKLIB SPP extractor, same GPS/BeiDou five-feature definitions; independent SPAN positions and building masks used only for reference labels
dataset.label_warning: Static-building map-derived references, not independently verified satellite reception truth. Dynamic obstacles and LOS multipath are not labelled; near-boundary/poor-truth/uncovered rows are unknown.

plan.protocol: Frozen KLT models to unseen UrbanNav districts; additionally six whole-drive train/validation/test district permutations inside UrbanNav
plan.selection_policy: Existing KLT source validation thresholds for external transfer; other-district validation only for UrbanNav checkpoints and thresholds; no target-test tuning

report_scope: Current aggregate and per-district metrics; no raw observations.
